endpoints.summary: Check that the API is running and see which mode it is in.

responses.when: Always.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Always "healthy".

fields.name: demo_mode
fields.description: True when no Firebase key is configured. Sign-in is then off and nothing is stored.

fields.name: connected_clients
fields.description: Always 0. Kept from the Flask API, where it counted Socket.IO connections.

fields.name: active_sessions
fields.description: Recordings in progress right now.

fields.name: live_devices
fields.description: Devices that have sent at least one reading since the API started.

endpoints.summary: Send one reading from the bat sensor.
notes: The reading is added to every running session that listens to this device_id.
The body is read as JSON whatever the Content-Type header says.
Numbers may also be sent as text, for example "1.5".

fields.name: device_id
fields.description: Name of the bat sensor. Defaults to "unknown".

fields.name: ax, ay, az
fields.description: Acceleration on each axis, in g. A missing value counts as 0.

fields.name: gx, gy, gz
fields.description: Rotation speed around each axis, in degrees per second. A missing value counts as 0.

fields.name: ts
fields.description: The sensor's own clock. Accepted and ignored.

responses.when: The reading was accepted.
The body is an empty JSON value: {}, [], "", 0, false or null.
The body is missing, is not valid JSON, is not a JSON object, or a value is not a number. The error text names the problem and varies.

endpoints.summary: List the devices that have sent readings, and how recently.
notes: Devices are listed in the order they were first seen. The list is kept in memory and is empty after a restart.

responses.when: Always. The list is empty until a device has sent a reading.

fields.name: devices[].device_id
fields.description: Name the device sent.

fields.name: devices[].last_seen
fields.description: Seconds since the device's latest reading.

fields.name: devices[].online
fields.description: True when the latest reading is less than 5 seconds old.

fields.name: count
fields.description: Number of devices in the list.

endpoints.summary: Start recording readings from one device.
notes: Each user has at most one running session. Starting again discards the running one without storing it.
The session collects only readings whose device_id matches.

fields.name: device_id
fields.description: Device to record. Defaults to "CRICPRO_BAT_001".

responses.when: The session started.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Always "started".

fields.name: session_id
fields.description: New 8-character id for this session.

endpoints.summary: Stop the caller's session and get its scores.
notes: No request body.
With a Firebase key configured, the analytics are also stored in Firestore as sessions/{session_id}. If storing fails, the scores are still returned.

responses.when: The session recorded at least one reading.

fields.name: analytics.session_id
fields.description: Id of the session.

fields.name: analytics.uid
fields.description: Firebase uid of the owner. "demo-user" in demo mode.

fields.name: analytics.device_id
fields.description: Device that was recorded.

fields.name: analytics.started_at, ended_at
fields.description: Start and stop time in UTC.

fields.name: analytics.duration_seconds
fields.description: Whole seconds between start and stop.

fields.name: analytics.total_readings
fields.description: Readings recorded.

fields.name: analytics.swing_count
fields.description: Times the speed rose above 25 km/h straight after a reading below 15 km/h.

fields.name: analytics.peak_speed_kmh
fields.description: Highest bat speed. Capped at 160.

fields.name: analytics.avg_speed_kmh
fields.description: Average bat speed over all readings.

fields.name: analytics.peak_power_watts, avg_power_watts
fields.description: Highest and average estimated power.

fields.name: analytics.peak_accel_g
fields.description: Highest acceleration, in g.

fields.name: analytics.timing_score
fields.description: Higher when the speed is steadier across readings above 20 km/h. 50 when fewer than two readings are that fast.

fields.name: analytics.control_score
fields.description: Higher when rotation around the z axis varies less. 50 for a single reading.

fields.name: analytics.sweet_spot_pct
fields.description: Readings above 2.5 g and 20 km/h, divided by the swing count, times 100. Not capped at 100.

fields.name: analytics.follow_through_pct
fields.description: Speed kept in the readings after the peak. 75 when the session has 10 readings or fewer.

fields.name: analytics.overall_score
fields.description: Timing 30%, control 25%, peak speed 25%, sweet spot 20%.

responses.when: The session received no readings from its device. Nothing is stored.
The caller has no running session.

endpoints.summary: List the caller's stored sessions, newest first.
notes: Returns at most 50 sessions.
Sessions are stored only when a Firebase key is configured.

responses.when: Sessions were read from Firestore. The list is empty when the user has none.
Demo mode. The list is always empty.
Firestore could not be read, for example because the query's index is missing. The status stays 200 and the reason is in error.

body.error: FAILED_PRECONDITION: The query requires an index.

notes: {id} is the 8-character session id.
Only the session's owner may read it.

responses.when: The session exists and belongs to the caller. The body is the stored analytics.
The session belongs to another user.
No session has this id.
Demo mode. Nothing is stored, so there is nothing to read.
Firestore could not be read. The error text varies.

notes: Only the session's owner may delete it.

responses.when: The session existed, belonged to the caller, and is now deleted.
No session has this id, or it belongs to another user. The two cases are not told apart.
Demo mode.
Firestore failed. The error text varies.

endpoints.summary: Get the caller's account details and overall stats.
notes: The stats are added up from the caller's stored sessions each time.
If the stored sessions cannot be read, the stats are all 0 and the status is still 200.

responses.when: The caller is signed in and the account was found.

fields.name: uid
fields.description: Firebase uid.

fields.name: email, display_name, photo_url
fields.description: From the Firebase account. null when the account has none.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When the account was created, in milliseconds since 1970.

fields.name: stats.total_sessions
fields.description: Stored sessions.

fields.name: stats.total_swings
fields.description: Sum of swing_count over those sessions.

fields.name: stats.best_score
fields.description: Highest overall_score.

fields.name: stats.avg_speed
fields.description: Average of the sessions' avg_speed_kmh, to one decimal.

responses.when: The caller is signed in but the account lookup failed. Only the stats are returned.
Demo mode. A fixed demo profile.

notes: The fields are merged into the Firestore document users/{uid}, together with uid and updated_at.
Fields other than the three below are ignored.

fields.name: display_name
fields.description: Defaults to an empty text.

fields.name: team
fields.description: Defaults to an empty text.

fields.name: batting_style
fields.description: Defaults to "right".

responses.when: The profile was stored.
Demo mode. Nothing is stored.
Firestore could not be written. The error text varies.

endpoints.summary: Start simulated readings, to try the API without a bat.
notes: Readings arrive for the device DEMO_BAT 50 times a second until the API is stopped.
Calling it again changes nothing.
The simulated swing is very slow, so a session recorded from it shows speeds near zero.

responses.when: Always.

common.when: A sign-in endpoint was called without the header Authorization: Bearer <token>.
A sign-in endpoint was called with a token that Firebase rejects: malformed, expired, or from another project.
The JSON body of start session or update profile could not be parsed.
Start session or update profile got a body whose Content-Type is not JSON.

body.error: No static resource api/nope for request '/api/nope'.

common.when: The path exists but not with this method.
